templates.description: Runtime-generated Basic SMTP mail sender implemented with Python standard library smtplib and email.message.EmailMessage. Supports Agent Studio connection schema, local secret schema, approval policy, mock SMTP sandbox verification, and real SMTP send mode.

files.content:
from tool import run

# Missing configuration must not be registered as a successful delivery.
missing = run({"to": ["a@example.invalid"], "subject": "T", "body": "B"})
assert missing["status"] == "requires_configuration"

# Sandbox verification must build an EmailMessage and exercise mock SMTP path.
verified = run({
    "mode": "verify",
    "to": ["a@example.invalid"],
    "subject": "verification",
    "body": "verification body",
    "_runtime": {
        "connection": {
            "smtp_host": "localhost",
            "smtp_port": 2525,
            "security": "none",
            "from_address": "sender@example.invalid",
            "transport_mode": "mock"
        },
        "secrets": {"password": "hidden"},
        "secret_refs": {"password": "runtime-secret-ref"}
    }
})
assert verified["status"] == "success"
assert verified["data"]["smtp_library"] == "smtplib"
assert verified["data"]["message_library"] == "email.message.EmailMessage"
assert verified["data"]["external_action_executed"] is False
assert verified["data"]["smtp_sendmail_called"] is True
assert verified["provenance"]["mock_smtp_verification"] is True
print("ok")

# basic_smtp_mail_sender

Runtime-generated Basic SMTP mail sender using Python standard library smtplib and email.message.EmailMessage. Supports dry-run/mock verification and real SMTP send when runtime connection and secret values are provided.
